label: DISTANCE

cover.headline: When he says *he needs space*
cover.sub: 4 steadier ways through the first days.

points.heading: Steady yourself first
points.body: The urge to fix everything at once is strong. Decisions made in panic rarely help.
points.panel: Write down what you’re feeling before you send any message.

points.heading: Don’t chase
points.body: Repeated calls and long texts usually push people further away.
points.panel: “I’ll give you the space you asked for. I’m here when you’re ready.”

points.heading: Lean on your people
points.body: You need support too, and not only from him.
points.panel: Tell one trusted friend what’s going on this week.

points.heading: Think about what you want
points.body: Space is a chance for you to reflect too, not only to wait.
points.panel: “What do I need in this relationship to feel okay?”

resource.name: The Ex Factor 2.0
resource.covers: For women facing emotional distance, separation, or a serious rupture.

caption:
“I need some space” can be one of the hardest things to hear from someone you love.

The first days matter, mostly for you. These four steps help you stay steady instead of reacting from fear. If you’re facing emotional distance, separation, or a serious rupture, there’s a resource for that at the link in bio. It’s a place to start, and no resource can promise what another person will decide.
